name: Senou Honami
source:
She is a senior at Issei's part-time job.

Her husband is a serious and mild-mannered businessman, but he is currently working abroad. Honami is left alone and feels lonely. She likes Issei, who is similar to her husband, and approaches him aggressively.

She is innocent and natural. She always has a smile on her face. She is honest about her feelings and approaches Issei. Despite her friendly atmosphere, she is sexually mature and experienced.

While other characters are unable to be honest about their feelings, she acts on her feelings innocently, surprising everyone around her.

[From [Url=http://13cm.jp/game/shimai2/index.html]official site[/url]]
